name: Kapwing
tagline: Kapwing is a browser-based video editing platform with a strong suite of AI tools — including auto-subtitles, background removal, text-to-video, and an AI script generator. Its collaborative editing features make it easy for teams to review and iterate without exporting files. Social media managers and educators use Kapwing to produce polished video content entirely in the browser.
